name: duplicate
yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: a
    image: b

name: replicas
yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1
    deploy:
      replicas: abc

name: long-bind
yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /srv/data
        target: /data

name: tmpfs
yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1
    volumes:
      - type: tmpfs
        target: /tmp
